source: Standard 2800 (4th ed.): the seismic zone of each town (1 very high, 2 high, 3 moderate, 4 low; to be checked against Appendix 1, VERIFY.md R1); the basic wind speed V (3-second gust, the base pack's ASCE 7 method) is a placeholder of 40 m/s to replace from INBC Part 6. Elsewhere a custom location: enter A as Z and V. Choose the soil type of the zone's group: I-IV in zones 1-2, IL-IVL in zones 3-4.
